title: Dont Attack My Logs!
description: This Mod adds a entity that spawns and attacks the player that breaks a random number of logs
body:
Log Spirit - Dont attack my logs!

This mod introduces a brand-new hostile entity known as the Log Spirit.
Every time a player chops down trees, the forest keeps count. Once you’ve broken a random number of logs, the spirit awakens and comes for you.

The Log Spirit isn’t just another mob — it’s a relentless force of nature. It’s tough, fast, and will not stop chasing until you’re defeated. You can run, you can hide, but once it spawns, it will hunt you down without mercy.

Features:

Unique mechanic – every player has their own hidden “log counter.”, Every time you Hit A random number of logs between 50 and 200, the spirit will just spawn just for you.

Dangerous enemy – high damage, strong health, and designed to give even well-equipped players a real challenge.

Persistent AI – the Log Spirit won’t give up easily; it keeps chasing until the fight is over.

Replay variety – every wood-gathering session could suddenly turn into a deadly boss-like encounter.

This mod adds a new layer of tension to one of Minecraft’s most basic actions: chopping wood. What was once routine survival gameplay now carries a risk — take too much from the forest, and the forest will take something back.

Are you ready to face the wrath of the woods?
